records.label: iou-definition-and-threshold
records.source: **IoU**, intersection over union, divides the overlap between predicted and reference objects by their combined area. Read scores with their threshold: "F1 0.864 at IoU 0.5" counts a vacuole as found when that overlap reaches half the combined area.
records.translation: **IoU** (intersection over union) dividerar överlappningsarean mellan det förutsagda objektet och referensobjektet med arean av deras union. Läs poäng tillsammans med tröskelvärdet: ”F1 0.864 vid IoU 0.5” räknar en vakuol som hittad när överlappningen når minst halva unionens area.
